notes: ONE TRANSPORT. Every clock in the app is now properly linked: the metronome, the Jam band, the Studio loop and the Arrange song are mutually exclusive — starting any one cleanly stops the others, so no more doubled unsynced clicks. The context-bar play button now drives whichever transport your space owns: the metronome in Practice, the loop in the Studio (the song on the Timeline) — and it pulses with the Studio's beat too. LUMI COLORS: two color pickers in Settings > MIDI let you dial the root and in-scale key colors by eye (LEDs render colors differently than screens) with live push on every change, plus the keybed brightness is pushed to 100%. Honest note added: the Studio loop and Jam currently play 4/4; the context-bar signature drives the metronome.
